verdict.rationale: BigQuery's Gemini/Conversational Analytics and Data Canvas features let users query, join, explore, and visualize data using natural-language input, and generate/explain SQL or Python code from natural language, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically validating the natural-language conversational analytics experience (community evidence found only covers pricing/performance, not NL usage), and clarity on how broadly this feature is available (GA vs preview).
